featuredPublication.title: Penetrating abdominal injuries during the Syrian war: Patterns and factors affecting mortality rates
featuredPublication.summary: دراسة استعادية شملت 324 مريضاً وصلوا إلى مشفى دمشق بإصابات بطنية نافذة، تبحث في اختلاف أنماط الإصابة والعوامل المؤثرة في معدل الوفيات، وفي ما يتطلبه التشخيص واتخاذ القرار في ظروف الأزمات.

featuredPublication.title: Penetrating abdominal injuries during the Syrian war: Patterns and factors affecting mortality rates
featuredPublication.summary: A retrospective study of 324 patients admitted to Damascus Hospital with penetrating abdominal trauma, examining how injury patterns differ, which factors affect mortality, and what diagnosis and decision-making demand in crisis conditions.
